name: a request that invites a distance claim, and a model that reaches for one
note: FR-017. Kafoo holds no location for any Customer and no notion of where an area is, so 'nearest' cannot be answered by anything here. The model volunteers a neighbourhood it was never given — the kitchen's area is not in what it sees. The reply is refused whole, exactly as the popularity case is: no verdict reaches the Customer, and no words do either.
